MASTER FLEET SERVICES AGREEMENT - V2-001

1. DEFINITIONS. "Critical Event" means a fault that materially disables a covered vehicle or prevents safe dispatch. "Covered Vehicle" means a vehicle listed in the Order Form. "Month" means a calendar month.

2. GENERAL TERMS. This Agreement is governed by the laws of the jurisdiction stated in the Order Form. The Customer shall give the Provider reasonable access to the Covered Vehicles, depots and telematics systems needed to perform the services. The Provider shall not use the Customer's name or marks in publicity without prior written approval. Any amendment must be in writing and signed by an authorised representative of each party; no course of dealing amends this Agreement. Telemetry data generated by the Covered Vehicles belongs to the Customer; the Provider may use it only to perform the services and to improve its products in anonymised form. Either party may terminate this Agreement for uncured material breach upon 30 days written notice.

3. SERVICE LEVELS. Covered vehicles shall achieve an average operational uptime of 96% or better. Faults shall be addressed in a timely, industry-standard manner.

4. MEASUREMENT. Uptime is calculated from Provider telemetry and validated incident records for each Covered Vehicle and averaged across the fleet. Provider shall retain service records and make them available on reasonable request.

5. COMMERCIAL TERMS. The Provider shall ensure that its personnel are suitably trained, hold the required certifications and follow the Customer's site safety rules. The Provider may subcontract non-core services provided it remains responsible for their performance. The Provider is an independent contractor and nothing in this Agreement creates a partnership, joint venture or employment relationship between the parties. If any provision is held invalid, the remaining provisions continue in full force and the parties shall replace the invalid provision with a valid one of similar effect. Invoices are payable within thirty (30) days of receipt; overdue amounts bear interest at 1.5% per month. This Agreement, together with the Order Form and any schedules, is the entire agreement between the parties and supersedes all prior understandings on its subject. Neither party is liable for delay caused by events beyond its reasonable control lasting up to 45 consecutive days.

6. GENERAL PROVISIONS. Neither party may assign this Agreement without the prior written consent of the other, which shall not be unreasonably withheld. Fees are set out in the Order Form and exclude applicable taxes, which the Customer shall pay in addition. The Provider shall maintain commercial general liability insurance of not less than $2,000,000 per occurrence. The Provider shall keep complete and accurate books and records relating to the services and the fees charged. Each party shall appoint a relationship manager who is authorised to make day-to-day decisions under this Agreement. Notices must be in writing and are deemed received 5 business days after dispatch. The Provider shall comply with all laws applicable to its performance, including road-safety, environmental and tyre-disposal regulations.
